title: 15.75. Saraṇaduka, Vitakkattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Saraṇaṁ savitakkasavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo nasavitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Araṇaṁ savitakkasavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naaraṇo nasavitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe dve …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate cattāri.
Saraṇaṁ avitakkavicāramattaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo naavitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe dve …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate cattāri.
Araṇaṁ avitakkaavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo naavitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
